newsitem.title: FRANCE: 30 people hurt in Channel Tunnel fire.
newsitem.headline: 30 people hurt in Channel Tunnel fire.

text.p: Fire broke out in a train carrying trucks through the Channel tunnel, injuring 30 people, rescue workers said on Tuesday.
It was one of the worst accidents in the tunnel linking France and Britain since it opened in 1994.
Two people were overcome by fumes and another 28 suffered slight breathing problems in the fire on Monday night near the French end of the tunnel.

The injured were treated in the tunnel and safely evacuated in another shuttle train to the French side as fire brigades were called out in the Pas-du-Calais and the Nord departments of northern France.
Trucks are transported round the clock aboard special trains 730 metres (yards) long through the tunnel, operated by Franco-British company Eurotunnel.
Each shuttle has two locomotives and can transport up to 28 large trucks through the 50 km (32 mile) tunnel.
